x: Over a 3 miles road course on December 8th from Belgrave Hall, we had six starters. The winner was a well built athlete, J.
Eddie Short came next followed by Ellis, and the next Maidenhead man was in 18th position so it will be seen that they found the opposition a bit too strong for them. The handicap was won by J.
Our other members' times and placings were—11, A. Bedford, 31.56; 12, J.
Then followed Bob Taylor, Denis Brickwood and J.
The Middlesex event was held at Trent Park and here again Cadogan A.C. were weakened by the absence of Vern Blowfield, Tony Snoad, "Ginger" Newell and J.

We were glad to see John Bromley getting back to his old form in third place and as Whenman is only a second-claim member, and so, not eligible for a championship medal, Eddie Short took the third place award. Eric Herbert and J.
